description:
Target: lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge/incoming.ex:24 (the nil integration branch of normalize/3). Scope is tests only; do not alter production behavior. Action reuse: not applicable; no operations/API changes.

Exclusive test path: test/zaq/channels/incoming_normalization_test.exs. Extend this existing async: true ExUnit module rather than the large bridge test; no other test files or support files need edits.

Test-first scenario: add a test for Zaq.Channels.JidoChatBridge.Incoming.normalize/3 using an unregistered provider such as "unsupported-provider" and assert exactly %{}. Pass a deliberately malformed/opaque incoming sentinel (e.g. :not_an_incoming) and an adapter sentinel (e.g. :not_an_adapter), verifying the unsupported path never accesses incoming.channel_meta/raw/timestamp, never calls enrich/2 or a provider adapter, and never produces trusted conversation_type/source_scope/provider_sent_at facts. An explicit nil or nil-like unsupported provider may be a second assertion only if consistent with the public to_string/1 contract; avoid testing unsupported arbitrary types that raise before the target branch. Optionally assert Incoming.integration("unsupported-provider") == nil as a diagnostic, but do not substitute it for the normalize/3 assertion. Do not weaken existing assertions. Prefer fixed unsupported provider string rather than a property generator here: finite provider registration with one target branch has no broad input-space invariant; existing property coverage in this file protects contradictory transport room facts.

Fixtures/helpers: reuse the existing alias/test structure in the normalization test; add alias Zaq.Channels.JidoChatBridge.Incoming if useful. No DB fixture, factories, new helpers or processes. Mocks: none; the nil branch returns before any adapter callback. Keep async: true: no application configuration, global-state mutation, process registration, external I/O or timing/sleeps. If an integration path is later requested, note that JidoChatBridge.normalized_communication_facts/2 calls adapter_for/1 first, so unknown providers cannot reach normalize/3 through the normal bridge; do not force this path through mocks/global state or modify production just for coverage.

Validation (implementer only): run targeted mix test test/zaq/channels/incoming_normalization_test.exs; report assertion result and whether line 24 is hit when the parent performs the final targeted --cover run. Do not run full suite, coveralls or mix q in this issue; parent owns mix q and final targeted --cover. No new feature E2E; this is a pure unit regression of fail-closed normalization. Blockers/unreachable branches: line 24 is reachable by direct normalize/3 invocation; it is unreachable via standard bridge ingress for unknown provider because adapter_for/1 rejects the provider first. If direct unit test does not mark line 24, inspect stale/incompatible coverage instrumentation and report rather than inventing an ingress workaround.
title: [coverage] Cover unsupported-provider normalization in Jido chat Incoming
